sourceAnchors.claim: Core scenario and rules structs are source-backed: race, caste, battle, monster, maps, thief, treasure, encounters, spell, itemattr, and shop.
Endian conversion routines identify owned fields for item attributes, maps, thief encounters, monsters, simple/complex encounters, battles, and shops.
Startup loads shared item groups from Data ID and supply defaults from Data NI evidence before scenario selection.
Startup loads shared spell data from Data S and shared/override race data through openrace.
openrace/opencaste use scenario Data Race/Data Caste for third-party scenarios when present, otherwise shared Data Files fallbacks.
selectscenario optionally opens scenario Data Spell and resource fork evidence.
loaditem resolves item IDs by 200-record groups: weapons, armor, helms, magic, and supplies.
loadspell2 decodes packed spell IDs into caste, level, and spell slot.
Data MENU is rebuilt from Data MD and should be treated as generated monster-menu evidence.
